name: scala-psi-host
description: Scala diagnostics, navigation, symbols and semantic colors from the IntelliJ Scala plugin, through the scala-psi-host language server.

scalaPsiHost.serverPath.description: Path to bin/scala-psi-host of a built distribution (sbt dist).

scalaPsiHost.javaHome.description: JDK 25 home for the server. Empty: the JAVA_HOME of VS Code's environment.

scalaPsiHost.debugLog.description: Log every request the server answers, with its time (SCALA_PSI_HOST_LOG=debug). Takes effect when the server restarts.
